title: galium verum var. consanguineum
intro: Galium verum var. consanguineum, commonly known as Wood Betony, is a perennial herb belonging to the Rubiaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, relieve headaches, and reduce anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Wood Betony include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as irritable bowel syndrome, fever, and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Wood Betony include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
